lines: Manish Sharma, Promoter Selling Shareholder, is offering up to ₹6.08 crore of shares in the offer for sale (up to 45,000 shares), with the sale taking effect at listing (trading start March 11, 2026).
This is a timely call because the offer and listing timing are set, so the client may want to discuss the sale before trading starts.
Retained holding is estimated at ₹110.73 crore at the offer price; the proceeds figure is an upper bound, since employee-portion shares sell at a discount.
Family link: 'Priyanka Manish Sharma' contains 'Manish Sharma', so a related party may be involved. Gain on the sale is unknown because average cost of acquisition is not verified.
